chunks: 1001 - And Zurarah narrated from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man forgot the first opening takbir. So he said: "If he remembers it before the ruku', he should say the takbir, then recite, then perform ruku'. And if he remembers it during the salat, he should say it in his place, at the position of the takbir, before the recitation or after the recitation."
I said: Then if he remembers it after the salat? He said: "Then let him make it up, and there is nothing upon him."

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةِ الِافْتِتَاحِ: the opening takbir that begins the prayer
key_terms.فَلْيَقْضِهَا: let him make it up afterward

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget Takbirat al-Iftitah in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on one who forgets the opening takbir in salat. It explains what to do depending on when the omission is remembered: before ruku', during the prayer, or after the prayer, and indicates that making it up removes blame.
